reviews.title: Works great; Very large, so measure first!
reviews.comment: This cooler is working great on my i5-14600K.  I'm not overclocking, but highs of 86'C during stress testing before undervolting, and in a relatively cool room. This is a large cooler. I naively never even looked at the measurements but just assumed it'd fit fine in my Silencio S400. I was lucky. It BARELY fit and it wouldn't have had my memory cards not been standard height. I decided on this cooler because it is one of the top rated fan coolers for the price and the cooler itself should last a lifetime (assuming adapters will be available for newer sockets), even if the fans eventually need replacing. Once installed, I verified my temps were very good on my new CPU and then I went ahead and undervolted to reduce temps further, and also got a decent bump in performance. This cooler was surprisingly loud until I improved on the fan curve. I saw a good comment online recently about how it is normal for CPU temps to fluctuate significantly, so there is no need to go chasing every rise in temp with fans.  Recommendation was to be more modest with fans until the temp really starts to rise. This made a lot of sense to me and my system is now a lot quieter and still plenty cool. Fan Control is a sweet and reputable Windows application for running fans; Definitely beats having to make adjustments thru BIOS, plus it is far more configurable and has some really intelligent features.
reviews.author: Brian J

reviews.title: Worth the price.
reviews.comment: This replaced a DeepCool AK620 Black cooler. The FROZN is cooling a AMD Ryzen 5 7600X CPU sitting in a Asus Prime X670E-PRO AMD X670 mobo along with a XFX Swift Radeon RX 9070 OC Triple Fan Gaming Edition with 16GB video card. I have NONE heating issues even after hours long gaming sessions. I'm very satisfied with this cooler.
reviews.author: JRVee

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.comment: This does better at cooling my Ryzen 5900X that a Noctua NH-D15 - by 3-5C.  At a fraction of the cost. It does get a bit louder than the NH-D15 during load but it is not an extreme difference. Installation is not difficult. One caveat: I broke one of the fans by accident (dropped it).  I tried to get a replacement from ID Cooling but no replies to my emails.  The Noctua NF-P14R works as a replacement - however, I think ID Cooling's fans for the A720 might generate a bit more static pressure.
reviews.author: eok

reviews.title: Cool my gaming PC well
reviews.comment: It is functional. It cools my gaming pc well on a very hot day. The noise is not particularly louder than others. It is easy to install. Good value for the moeny. The quality is really good. It does not have any RGB. As ling as you don’t mind about the look, I highly recommend it
reviews.author: Franco

reviews.title: Solid Choice For 9800X3D
reviews.comment: Bought for my 9800X3D and havent seen any temps higher than 66C in intensive productivity and gaming. Shockingly good value for a cooler of this price. It's performance punches far above its weight class while maintaining quiet noise levels at the same time. The packaging is good and the instructions are clear and precise as well. Additionally the standoffs are color coded so you shouldn't be able to screw up an install of this cooler at all. Installation was also easy with the sturdy screwdriver they give you. Unlike their competitors they give a tool that can be reused and isn't just plastic waste. Overall
